product_one_liner.value: Malachyte provides real-time AI personalization, search, and product recommendations for e-commerce retailers, adapting online shopping experiences to shoppers’ live behavior and intent, including anonymous visitors.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage describes multi-surface personalization; TechCrunch explains real-time intent-aware e-commerce personalization.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage/product navigation and footer offer a pilot program and site audit but no pricing link or public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both are presented in company case studies.

hq_location.notes: Company About page gives a New York, NY address; LinkedIn lists its headquarters in New York, NY.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook lists 2024 as the year founded.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains company news and marketing/product-oriented articles, but not two engineering-authored posts about product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data, incidents, or open source.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation contains multiple articles, including click tracking, Shopify setup, and recommendation setup.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page states there are no open positions right now.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public docs, blog, and privacy policy; none identifies an AI model or AI model provider. The privacy policy names Google Analytics only as an analytics example.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy page names no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification. The data processing agreement refers to security standards used by systems, which is not a public claim that Malachyte holds those certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $10 million seed round in August 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round was announced on August 6, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page states there are no open positions right now.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index's newest launch-type/product announcement is the August 6, 2026 company announcement, which reports the funding and describes the business rather than announcing a new product or major feature; other recent posts are explanatory or marketing articles.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile for Alexander Khan states he became VP, GTM at Malachyte in March 2026, inside the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public documentation and careers page are readable; the docs describe Shopify/headless integrations but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
